title: <dialog> Unclear method of altering/reading attributes
body:
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#dom-dialog-show

> Add an [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute to the [dialog](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#the-dialog-element) element, whose value is the empty string.

The spec is unclear how this attribute is added. It should use https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value, unless that isn't how the attribute should be added.

Other instances that should be linked:

> Add an [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute to subject, whose value is the empty string.

> If the element already has an [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute, then return.

> If subject already has an [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute, then throw an ["InvalidStateError"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

> Add an [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute to subject, whose value is the empty string.

> If isModal is true and subject has the [autofocus](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#attr-fe-autofocus) attribute, then set control to subject.

> If subject does not have an [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute, then return.

> Remove subject's [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#attr-dialog-open) attribute.

> If result is not null, then set the [returnValue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#dom-dialog-returnvalue) attribute to result.
